Indicators: Commercial fishery engagement, social vulnerability

return_plot("commercial-engagement", region = "MidAtlantic", mode = "slide")

:::

::: {.soe-50-column}

<br>
<br>

```{r comvultab}
ecodata::plot_community_factors(report = 'MidAtlantic',plottype = 'Commercial',varName = 'Social', n = 5) |> 
  flextable::flextable()
```

- More variability in the most commercially active ports -- Cape May and Reedville
- Increasing activity in Shinnecock/Hampton Bays
- Crew Survey shows inconsistent job satisfaction among crew and evidence of aging of the fleet

## Mid Atlantic Social and Cultural

Indicators: Commercial fishery revenue climate vulnerability

:::: {.soe-50-50-slide}

::: {.soe-50-column}

```{r commvulex}
return_plot("commvulex", region = "MidAtlantic", mode = "slide")
```

- Measures of how dependent communities are on species sensitive to environmental variability (temperature, acidifcation, etc.)
- Most communities, especially those in the Chesapeake Bay, are highly dependent on species that are very highly sensitive to environmental variability
- On average, Mid Atlantic communities' landings are _moderately dependent_ on species sensitive to environmental variability, while community revenue is _highly dependent_ on species sensitive to environmental variability. 

:::
